modelConfiguration: TF-IDF word 1-2 grams, min_df=1, max_features=30000, sublinear_tf; LR C=1 balanced liblinear; weighted title:body=3:1; seed=20260905
protocol: Provisional development evidence; no holdout inputs, no LLM calls. Classical results are 5-fold out-of-company predictions; synthetic tests never train models.

dataset.exclusion: All title groups from both existing frozen holdout manifests removed before any development text is viewed. No holdout references or predictions exported.
dataset.source: public posting caches; classifier fields excluded
dataset.labelProvenance: Codex editorial review of title and public duties, before candidate scores; provisional, not independently human-adjudicated ground truth. No external LLM inference or model-generated cache fields used.
dataset.labelDefinition: KEEP technical/software/systems/integration/automation/IT duties and ambiguous adjacent engineering/support; REJECT explicit unrelated primary occupation. Product/employer industry and merely using software/AI are not technical duties. No seniority, travel, location, education or certification disqualifiers.
dataset.selection: Stable SHA256(seed|id) order, unique normalized titles; sequential stratum quotas 15, technical 60, background 30. No selection based on labels or classifier predictions.
dataset.exclusionVerification: Sampler removed matching stableId, content hash, and every normalized title group from both frozen holdout manifests before exporting eligible text. Holdout examples/labels/predictions were never read for candidate development.
limitations: Single editorial reviewer; uncertainty maps to KEEP.
Purposive negative-rich development sample, not a prevalence estimate.
No hospitality and only one security-title match in real strata; synthetic tests report separately.
Exact-title exclusion does not prove semantic independence from historical holdout; use fresh prospective evidence before deployment.
dataset.exclusionCountNote: Original count 250 excludes only nonempty descriptions; audited count 253 also includes three excluded empty-description records. Both yield the identical 1503-row eligible pool.
